title: Annotatio V §.X: Wittenberger §.XVIII counters — Indignorum not light; Reformed err on presence
pass_a_gloss: The dearest Wittenberger rejoins two things in §. XVIII. (1) That the error about Eating of the Unworthy is not light. (2) That about the very presence of Body & Blood of Christ, and Sacramental Eating, error is most certainly committed by the Reformed, however it may be palliated.
pass_b_english: The Wittenberg friend (§.XVIII) replies with two counters: first, the Indignorum error is not a light one.
Second, he says it is certain the Reformed err on the presence of body and blood and on sacramental eating — however they soften the charge.
source_text: Cariss. Wittebergensis, duo regerit §. XVIII. (1) Errorem de Manducatione Indignorum, levem non esse (2) Circa ipsam Corp. & Sang. Christi præsentiam, & Sacramen. Manducationem, a Reformatis errorem committi, utcunque etiam pallietur, certissimum esse.
